描述_EN: the painted decoration depicts the empress wu zetain from an illustration in wu shuang pu, 'a register of the incomparable'. the bottle is a cylindrical form made of porcelain and painted in enamel colours, green, red, yellow, blue, brown, black and pink. there is gilding on the flat upper surface of the neck rim and no stopper. the inscription is a contracted version of her biography in that publication. the body of the bottle slops towards a sharp foot with a high curved indentation underneath.
描述_ZN: 彩绘装饰描绘的是武则天皇后，出自《武圣普》中的插图。 该瓶为圆柱形，由瓷器制成，涂有珐琅彩，绿色、红色、黄色、蓝色、棕色、黑色和粉色。 颈部边缘的平坦上表面有镀金，没有塞子。 铭文是该出版物中她的传记的缩略版本。 瓶身向尖底倾斜，下面有一个高的弧形压痕。
